## What it is

Front bezel and backplate for the 160 mm WS2812B matrix, with the same baffle track, diffuser slot and four base-mount screws as `matrix_16x16_housing`, plus four more M3 holes that bolt on the Arduino shell.

## Design notes

- The stepped pocket, 45 degree corbels, open top mouth and six anti-warp windows are copied from the original housing so the same 162.4 mm baffle and 162 mm diffuser slide in.
- Two strips of the upper side windows are filled back in where the shell's left and right walls land, so the bay perimeter has plastic to sit on.
- Shell screws are on the 10 mm pixel grid at `(-30, 30)`, `(-30, 50)`, `(30, 30)` and `(30, 60)`, with the same recessed M3 heads as the base-mount screws.

## Don't

- Don't close the top mouth above the PCB pocket. That is how the baffle and the diffuser slide in.
- Don't move the four base-mount holes off `(+/-30, -60)` and `(+/-30, -30)`. Both the original base mount and the desk stand use them.
- Don't chamfer the bed face or the sliding tracks.
